searchText: Are we going to name this upgrade for EIP-4490 and EIP-4488? We haven't really agreed to it yet, but if we do, then yes 🙂 Will check it out! <@!97774605351010304> just tried creating one for the merge community call this Friday. Let us know if this is useful! Also, if someone knows of a bot that can take a Github issue and create an event like this out of it, that'd be useful 😄 Definitely useful! Ok good to know. They are a _bit_ more work to create but not a ton, so if folks find them useful happy to do it. If we can automate it, even better 😄 Also just created one for the next AllCoreDevs Some nice EIP-4488 analysis by Nick Johnson: https://twitter.com/nicksdjohnson/status/1465104492769079297 Sounds like against the Blockchain moto but the biggest advantage of this system is to have a centralized place to get all events. So if all groups in the server (and some outside like the portal network) would post their meetings in that system, I'd hope to see more participation
